value.rationale: A mathematically natural probabilistic invariant from random Galois/Frobenius-type generation is determined for all tuple lengths in an infinite semisimple Frobenius family; in a high-multiplicity regime that cannot be invariably two-generated, exact Gaussian cutoff and the nontrivial bounded additive correction to mean waiting time quantify a sharp threshold. This is stronger than a restated existence criterion, a k=2 graph or routine finite table; it can benchmark extensions to more general solvable groups.
